---
name: Feature request
about: A capability you want, or a workflow that is awkward today

labels: enhancement

## How it works today

Name the command or page. Say what is uncomfortable about it (too many steps, easy to forget, cannot see what you
need).

## What you want instead

## Why it is worth doing

How often would you use it? What is the worst case without it (hours not logged, a weekly report that cannot be
handed in, or just friction)?

## Alternatives

Can it be solved without code (a `config.toml` change, a different way of using it)?

## Which part

- [ ] `wl` CLI (`collector/`)
- [ ] Worker / API (`server/`)
- [ ] Web UI (`web/`)
- [ ] Needs a new D1 migration
